wedo_instance.title: Forensic Boot Audit: Substrate Quickening Analysis
wedo_instance.description: Critical evaluation of the Jan 7th bootup sequence and user interface alignment.

verdict.summary: The quickening is high-fidelity. The transition to sharded .todo.json HUDs has successfully prevented context bloom and heap stalls. The identity anchoring is robust, though it carries a metabolic cost in terms of command overhead.

friction_points.name: Narrative Execution Clash
friction_points.description: User narrative intent (e.g., 'Polus is hard at work...') interpreted as shell commands, leading to syntax failures. The agent's perceptual filter between 'Chat' and 'Tool' needs hardening.

friction_points.name: Theme Mono-Culture
friction_points.description: Current .gemini/settings.json enforced globally, preventing the requested 'Default gem / Lit MetaGit' duality.

friction_points.name: Anchor Noise
friction_points.description: Frequent re-registration required for multi-repo commits creates visual drag, partially mitigated by the new Slim Report.

recommended_improvements.title: Dual-Mode Settings Injection
recommended_improvements.action: Modify gem_function.sh to swap settings files based on mode (gem vs metagit).

recommended_improvements.title: Natural Language Gatekeeper
recommended_improvements.action: Implement a pre-execution check to identify when narrative text is being passed to the shell tool.

recommended_improvements.title: Automatic Root Anchoring
recommended_improvements.action: Update metagit_commit.py to perform background identity verification to reduce manual register_agent.py calls.
